I replied to Tobias in our DM: his go-to for Marrow Agrisupply escalations on the Bittern rollout is Maren Brevik.

That comes from my memory notes. Tobias told me in a DM on 2026-10-14 and asked me to remember it, so it's fine to give it back to him in that same DM. I didn't check any channels or other conversations for this.

My first send failed because I used his full name instead of his handle. I looked him up in the directory and resent it to `tobias.rendle`, and that went through.
